info.name: Bid on This
info.description: Senior User Interface Developer, Scrum Master, for this new start-up, on-line auction site.
info.front end technologies used: HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Responsive Design/Media Queries, Object Orientated JavaScript, Angular, SASS, Compass, FontAwesome, Grunt, Bower, Jasmine, Twitter Bootstrap3 WordPress.
info.additional information: This start-up on-line auction site engaged me as a senior front end developer. My duties included producing new adaptive layouts and styling to the main pages of the site including all user interactions, I was also asked to use my design/UX knowledge to introduce a consistent look and feel between the web application and the WordPress CMS. In addition, I was tasked with acting as scrum master on the project, mentoring and assisting the business team introduce agile techniques

info.name: Market.com
info.description: Senior User Interface Developer for this On-line e-commerce site for the owners of Camden Market
info.additional information: I was contracted by Born Group to act as the senior front end developer, on this project for the owners of Camden Market. The task was to re-skin and put a new Hybris back end on to their existing c-commerce site http://www.everything5pounds.com and to create a new and responsive sister site that used the same catalogue http://www.market.com. My responsibilities included, producing standard and responsive Page layouts and styling for all major pages, styling for the menu systems both mobile, desktop and to provide help, support and guidance to junior members of the team and back end developers

info.name: Hotels4u.com
info.description: Senior User Interface Developer for this On-line hotel booking site owned by the Thomas Cook Group.
info.front end technologies used: HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Object Orientated JavaScript, , jQuery, Modernizer, AJAX, LESS, Angular, Twitter Bootstrap 3, Responsive design, Media Queries.
info.additional information: I was engaged by Hotels4u.com, who are part of the Thomas Cook group, to produce the front-end/UI for their new responsive, hotel search and booking, ecommerce site. My responsibilities included, producing all page layouts and styling, including media queries to enable the site to render correctly across a full range of devices, from mobiles in portrait mode, to large desktop displays, also to enable the site to offer different functionality dependant on display size and device.

info.name: Pearson
info.description: Senior User Interface Developer for this Major global publishing house
info.front end technologies used: HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Responsive Design/ Media Queries, Object Orientated JavaScript, jQuery, Underscore, AJAX, SASS, FontAwresome, Twitter Bootstrap, XSLT.
info.additional information: I was contracted by this global publishing company, primarily to build and style the user interface to an XML based Global Content Authoring system. The system was built around the XOPUS XML editor and provided an interface that enabled authors to enter content to be stored in an XML schema that allowed it to be output to be in multiple formats. I also developed the front end to Pearson’s CHORUS (Content Hub, Organise, Re-Use, and Share) Extranet application.

info.name: Loreal
info.front end technologies used: HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Object Orientated JavaScript, HTML5 Video, jQuery, Modernizer, AJAX, LESS.
info.additional information: I was engaged by this interactive media/video production agency to build a responsive front end for an interactive web application for L’Oreal advertising campaign for their Studio Line #Txt range that was required to work across a range of devices, with differences in functionality depending on the device being used. The application allowed users to upload a number of images or short videos that are then edited together with various pre-recorded video clips and a sound track, to produce a final video that can then be previewed, added to the site and entered into a competition via social media.

info.name: Sportlabs
info.front end technologies used: HTML5, CSS3, Object Orientated JavaScript, JSON, jQuery, Knockout, Underscore, Parse, AJAX, Umbraco, Agile.
info.additional information: Because of my wide range of experience, I was contracted by this small start-up company, who specialise in sports related sites and mobile applications, to provide support in a variety of areas. My primary function was to help develop the web side of a tournament planning application for the Lawn Tennis Association.

info.name: The RAF Club
info.front end technologies used: HTML5, CSS/CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery,  AJAX, Orchard (.net) CMS, LESS, Twitter Bootstrap
info.additional information: While working for Micros Fidelio I also worked with the team producing the New RAF Club Website.

info.name: Thorntons

info.additional information: I worked for this e-commerce solutions vendor, to work on various hospitality, travel and e-commerce retail sites, including http://www.thorntons.co.uk and http://scottishpassport.currencyandmore.com adding new functionality.

info.name: Tesco Direct

Also to investigate and recommend improvements to working methods and technologies, within UI dept, i.e. the introduction of Q-unit, for JavaScript unit testing
info.front end technologies used: XHTML, CSS/CSS3, Object Orientated JavaScript, jQuery, Q-unit JS unit testing, AJAX, Agile.

HH Global
HHub
info.front end technologies used: XHTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Object Orientated JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Agile.
info.additional information: I was engaged by this global print management house primarily to produce the UI and to recommend best practices from a User Experience perspective  to HHUB (A web based brand campaign management tool), and secondly, due to my agile experience to assist the project manager and offer guidance in adopting Agile/Scrum procedures.

info.name: ASOS
info.additional information: This was a short term contract for this leading online fashion house. I was tasked with producing their online lookbook that is available to the trade and fashion press to show their up-coming collections, producing the front end and adding functionality to work cross browser and cross platform including iPad

info.name:
BBC
Accessibility Help
info.front end technologies used: Object Orientated JavaScript, JSON, jQuery, AJAX, CSS, XHTML
info.additional information:
I was working for the BBC's FM&T (Future Media & Technology) division, specifically working on the My Web My Way site www.bbc.co.uk/accessability, among my responsibilities were to add functionality to the site, in particular.
  1. Object Orientated JavaScript that modifies the DOM and therefore the user experience, according to choices of disability type, operating system and browser, made by the user
  2. Converting legacy JavaScript that switches stylesheets and text size according to the user’s choices, from the BBC’s Glow JavaScript library to jQuery.
  3. The addition of a JavaScript client side search functionality.
  4. The addition of social media sharing tools.
I was also part of the remit to prepare the site for migration and to migrate the site on-to the BBC's Web Application Development Platform (Forge).

info.additional information: On this short term contract for the Sevenoaks based agency Wickedweb I created the HTML Mock-ups and stylesheets for The Biggest Thank You for Macmillan Cancer Support.
